status: promoted to active design and independently digitally revalidated; fabrication not approved
scope: Retain AP63205 2A, LM5050-1, one PCB, original outline/connectors/power flow; no audio or battery-management circuitry added.

q2.land_interpretation: Rotated X=0.8, Y=0.9, C=2.0; E=1.35 reaches outer pad edge, so lower-pair centers are +/-0.95 and pitch is 1.90 mm.
q2.qualification: Exact suggested copper land and G/S/D net direction digitally checked; solder process/height/thermal/SOA not physically qualified.

r8.preserved: R8.2=C39.1=U10.VS; C39.2=GND; Q2 and U10 sensing/gate power direction unchanged.
r8.routing: Remove only two R8 terminal-branch +5V segments; add one through-via, 0.2mm bias route on B.Cu/In2.Cu. Local source copper keeps 0.5mm width and is rerouted to clear Q2 vendor land.

c39.supplier_identity_correction: C1525 identifies CL05B104KO5NNNC 16V, not 50V. Removed that purchasing ID; do not order C1525 as the new exact MPN.

battery_assumptions.interpretation: 6.0V is a design-envelope assumption, not a guaranteed pack cutoff. Must maintain measured LM5050 VS >=5V after R8 under operating conditions. No 5V battery-input operation claim. Removed legacy 7S/21-29V, 24V and 5A annotations.

usb_only_and_removal: With battery absent, the new VS bias is absent and LM5050 is outside its recommended operating range. Q2 body diode orientation opposes passive reverse current from +5V to the buck, but this does not qualify stored gate charge, controller leakage, power sequencing or reverse-current behavior. Do not claim safe isolation for all USB-only/removal modes. Simultaneous USB-C/HAT power remains prohibited until bench validation.

ideal_reference_calculations_not_qualifi.notes: 68mOhm is the datasheet maximum at VGS=2.5V, 25C, not a guaranteed hot-board value. Verify actual mixed VS/IN gate drive. R8 pulse model is ideal and does not establish resistor pulse/working-voltage qualification.

native_validation.tool: KiCad 10.0.6 native CLI + bundled Python pcbnew
native_validation.native_serialization_equivalence: All native tracks/pads compared identical before/after preserving unchanged original-format board blocks.

exact_copper_audit.note: Includes added/removed and edited records; this is not thirteen additional tracks.

physical_gates: Exact NP-F550 SKU/polarity/protection/cutoff and charger compatibility
R8 hot-plug pulse capability and VS filter behavior
VS and VGS measurements during startup, load steps, battery removal and USB-only operation
Q2 body-diode inrush/SOA, 2A hot-load voltage loss and thermal rise on actual copper
Q2 solder/stencil/assembly quality and actual stack-height clearance
Existing J4/C45/Radxa mechanics, RF, runtime and audio load-limit gates remain open
